s: LLMs aid planning by reducing friction and serving as a sounding board for common patterns, but struggle with innovation. Local LLMs can monitor and optimize their own development by digesting user actions.
sub: LLMs offer mid-range, well-trodden solutions, not innovation.
Local LLM for self-monitoring and development optimization via action logging.
Integrating LLMs into software development for planning and real-time feedback.
Leveraging RAG and vector databases for LLM data comprehension.
